items.source_en:
Ever since Peter died, I've been having a hard time sleeping. The whole story about the Pale Lady was cute at first, but now I get startled whenever the ship creaks. Too many old bones. In it, and me.

The Doc says it was pneumonia. Really? What kind of pneumonia turns a man's face white as chalk? When we get back, I want to bring Peter's body to the clinic, and get a proper autopsy.
